item.text:
C1 lost: 10 kills, 23 leaks, life −22. The geometry changed, but the support window failed earlier: Hibiscus deployed @1321, took shells @1421 and @1571, and died before Steward arrived. She never healed him. Steward attacked artillery @2071–2407 for 2,216.99 damage, then died @2443. The first leak was officer #11 @3141.

That gives C2 a concrete repair: restore Hibiscus’s late @1960 entry and move Ansel to [5,5] DOWN @1321. This frees Steward’s runtime (6,5) tile while retaining Ansel’s central coverage and skill coverage of Midnight. Hibiscus then covers both Ansel and Steward from two and three tiles away. Ansel’s first skill moves to @2072; later activations stay fixed.

C2 keeps the same seven IDs, costs, opening ground operators, and western transfers. Its test is Hibiscus surviving to Steward’s shell cadence and actually healing him, with sustained artillery damage and a kill. Ansel is adjacent to Steward and will share caster splash; that exposure and healing contention remain explicit risks. No extra heal is assumed sufficient. I’ll check opening survival, support/shell/output @1900–3400, then central and protected settlement.
